app.name: Simple APB
auth.username_hint: 3–32 characters: letters, numbers, dots, dashes, underscores.
auth.password_hint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords and your username.
auth.email_hint: Used only for account notices and password resets.
auth.message_hint: Tell the admin who you are, so they can approve you.
auth.age_confirm: I confirm I am old enough to use this service where I live.
auth.terms_accept: I accept the terms and privacy policy.
auth.no_terms: The admin has not written this yet.
auth.signup_sent: Request sent. An admin will review it; you can sign in once it's approved.
auth.totp_help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.recovery_help: Enter one of your one-time recovery codes.
totp.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
totp.required: Your account requires two-factor sign-in. Set it up to continue.
setup.title: Set up your server
setup.token.title: Setup token
setup.token.help: The server printed a one-time setup token in its log when it started (look for SETUP REQUIRED). Paste it here.
setup.token.label: Setup token
setup.admin.title: Admin account
setup.admin.totp_help: Scan this code with an authenticator app (Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.admin.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.admin.code_needed: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
setup.db.title: Database
setup.db.sqlite: simplest; stored in /config. Recommended for most servers.
setup.db.postgres: for large instances or if you already run Postgres.
setup.library.title: Library folder
setup.library.hint: The folder (inside the container) that holds your audiobooks.
setup.library.empty: The folder is writable and empty — fine for a new library.
setup.library.unusable: The server can't use this folder.
setup.url.title: Public address
setup.url.label: Public base URL
setup.url.hint: How phones and browsers reach this server, e.g. https://books.example.com. Used in links and casting.
setup.smtp.title: Email
setup.smtp.help: Optional. Used for sign-up decisions, password resets and admin alerts.
setup.ntfy.title: Push notifications (ntfy)
setup.ntfy.help: Phones get notifications through ntfy. With the bundled container the defaults work.
setup.ntfy.internal_hint: How this server reaches ntfy, e.g. http://ntfy:80.
setup.ntfy.public_hint: How phones reach ntfy, e.g. https://push.example.com.
setup.ntfy.token_hint: Leave empty to generate one automatically.
setup.instance.title: Your instance
setup.instance.name: Instance name
setup.instance.legal_warning: This is a template. Edit the privacy policy and terms so they describe how you run this server before opening sign-ups.
setup.terms.template:
TEMPLATE — edit before opening sign-ups.

This is a private, self-hosted audiobook server. Only upload books you have the right to share. The admin may remove content or accounts that break these rules.
setup.bandwidth.title: Bandwidth
setup.bandwidth.hint: The most bandwidth streaming and downloads may use in total. Keep it below your home upload speed.
setup.review.title: Review
setup.done.title: Your server is ready
setup.done.codes: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

error.account_pending: Your account is waiting for an admin to approve it.
error.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Your account is locked for a while.

error.invalid_token: Your sign-in expired. Please start again.
error.signup_closed: This server isn't accepting new accounts right now.
error.consent_required: Please confirm your age and accept the terms.
error.password_too_short: The password must be at least 10 characters.
error.password_too_common: That password is too common. Choose another.
error.password_matches_username: The password must not contain your username.
error.invalid_setup_token: That setup token is wrong. Copy it again from the server log.
error.setup_complete: This server is already set up.
error.library_unusable: The server can't use that library folder.
error.csrf_failed: Your session check failed. Reload the page and try again.
update.required: This app is too old for the server. Please update to continue.

settings.eink_tick_help: Fewer refreshes mean less ghosting on e-ink screens.
settings.quality_help: Automatic plays the original files, and the data saver on a mobile connection when the browser can tell.
settings.email_hint: Used only for account notices and password resets. Leave empty to remove it.
settings.conflict_threshold: Ask which position to keep when devices differ by more than

settings.listening_visible: Show me in “who's listening” on books I'm listening to
security.title: Security
security.password_mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
security.password_changed: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
security.totp_on: Two-factor sign-in is on. You need a code from your authenticator app to sign in.
security.totp_off: Two-factor sign-in is off. Turn it on to protect your account with a code from an authenticator app.
security.totp_required: Two-factor sign-in is required for your account, so it can't be turned off.
security.recovery_help: Lost your phone? Each recovery code signs you in once. Getting new codes makes the old ones stop working.
stats.title: {year} in listening
stats.chart_alt: {title}: bar chart of listening time. The same numbers are available as a table.
stats.empty_body: Your listening time, books and authors appear here once you've listened for a bit.
error.email_taken: That email is used by another account.
error.bad_email: That doesn't look like an email address.
error.bad_display_name: The display name must be 1 to 64 characters.
error.totp_required: Two-factor sign-in is required for your account.

admin.user.pending_hint: This account is waiting for approval in the Inbox.

admin.user.restrict_help: They can still listen, but can't upload, share, review or report.

admin.user.permissions_help: Inherit uses the user's tags, then the instance defaults. Allow or Deny overrides both.

admin.groups.name: Group name
admin.groups.delete_body: Books shared with this group are no longer shared with its members. The books themselves stay.
admin.tags.help: Tags change what people can do (most restrictive tag wins) and can require two-factor sign-in.
